fact: The Ministry of Finance's Public Financial Management Reform Strategy and Plan 2023-2027 costs the "Roll-Out of PFM Smart to Local Councils" at USD 4,175.6 thousand over 2023 to 2026, led by the Ministry's PFM Reform Division with the Fiscal Decentralisation Department, the Local Government Service Commission, the councils and the Accountant General's Department as partners and the World Bank's Accountable Governance project as funding source, with a web-based accounting and reporting model deployed to local councils by 2027 as its target; its baseline is that the councils' Petra application is not web-based and sits on standalone computers with limited or no local area network.
title: Public Financial Management Reform Strategy and Plan 2023 - 2027
publisher: Government of Sierra Leone, Ministry of Finance
